subject.title: Make agent identity preamble configurable (replace hardcoded 'personal assistant')

question: Should OpenClaw accept a narrow public config surface for replacing or suppressing the main-agent identity opener, and should that API be identityLine/identityMode, preamble, or SOUL-aware suppression?
rationale: The source-level gap is clear, but adding prompt identity config changes the durable operator contract and must fit OpenClaw's high config-surface bar.

options.title: Accept identityLine/identityMode
options.body: Approve the active PR's opt-in shape after refresh, docs/schema metadata, and upgrade/default proof.

options.title: Choose a different narrow API
options.body: Keep the issue open but ask for a replacement implementation using preamble or suppress-on-SOUL.md semantics.

options.title: Reject core prompt identity config
options.body: Close the active PR and route users to existing prompt/plugin/context mechanisms without adding a core config knob.

recommendation.title: Accept identityLine/identityMode
recommendation.body: Approve the active PR's opt-in shape after refresh, docs/schema metadata, and upgrade/default proof.
